title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Rates for a Single Remaining Dependent on a Disallowance
content:
For a dependency disallowance on an Unemployment Benefit Claims record, the per-dependent amount for the dependents remaining on record — the weekly amount that, multiplied by the dependents counted, gives the redetermined allowance — is scheduled as follows. The age of the claim is the number of calendar days from its effective date to the handling date.

| Dependents remaining on record | Age of the claim | Per-dependent amount (USD per week) |
|---|---|---|
| Exactly one | Fewer than 182 days | 18.00 (the new-claim single amount) |
| Exactly one | At least 182 days | 16.00 (the long-claim single amount) |
| None, or two or more | Any | The program's own per-dependent amount |

Any other disallowance uses the program's per-dependent amount.

## Both sides of the 182-day line (hypothetical)

| Dependents remaining | Age of the claim | Per-dependent amount |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 181 days | 18.00 |
| 1 | 182 days | 16.00 |
| 2 | 100 days | The program's own per-dependent amount |
